verdict.rationale: Through its included registered-agent service, VPM receives service of process and state correspondence, scans it the same day, and sends real-time email alerts, so legal and state mail gets an expedited, alerted path. There is no documented flagging or prioritization of government mail such as IRS letters arriving in the general mailbox; generic automation rules and tags are not shown to detect it. missing for 10: automatic flagging/prioritization of IRS and other government mail in the regular mailbox, deadline tracking or reminders, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an operator, government and legal mail — IRS, state filings, service of process — is flagged or prioritized so a compliance deadline never sits unread in the pile

citations.quote: As your registered agent, VPM will receive service of process, legal notices, and other important state correspondences on your behalf.
All legal documents served are scanned and available online the same day they are received so you have more time to respond.
